title: 宝林寺接叶信
subtitle: 一封求助信，也需要认真核对
origin: 《西游记》第三十六至三十七回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 收到重要消息时，先核对来源、倾听双方，再决定怎样帮助，能保护每一个人。
moral.en: When an important message arrives, checking its source and listening to every side helps protect everyone.

pages.zh: 师徒在宝林寺借宿。夜里，一片画着白鹤的树叶从窗外轻轻飘进来。
pages.en: The travelers stayed at Baolin Temple. At night, a leaf painted with a white crane drifted gently through the window.
pages.prompt: Full Journey to the West team rests in a warm lamplit temple room as a broad green leaf with a simple white crane picture drifts through an open window; calm mystery, no readable text.

pages.zh: 叶子背面没有名字，只有水晶花园、五尾白鹤和一轮弯月三个图案。
pages.en: The leaf had no name, only pictures of a crystal garden, a five-feathered crane, and a crescent moon.
pages.prompt: Close view of a broad leaf held safely by Wukong, bearing only three simple painted pictures: crystal garden, white crane with five tail feathers, crescent moon; no letters or text.

pages.zh: 八戒觉得像寻宝图，沙僧却提醒：“也可能是求助信，先别拿它开玩笑。”
pages.en: Bajie thought it looked like a treasure map, but Sha reminded him, “It may be a request for help. Let us not joke before we know.”
pages.prompt: Zhu Bajie in dark teal tunic and Sha Wujing in slate-blue robe thoughtfully discuss the picture leaf while Tang Seng and Wukong listen; tools resting safely aside, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空检查叶脉上的水珠和花粉，发现它们都来自乌鸡国王宫附近。
pages.en: Wukong examined water drops and pollen on the leaf and found that both came from near the palace of Wuji Kingdom.
pages.prompt: Wukong uses a round magnifying crystal to inspect dew and pale flower pollen on the leaf beside a small bowl of matching palace-garden flowers; scientific careful mood, no text.

pages.zh: 第二天，乌鸡国太子也拿出一枚五尾白鹤玉牌，图案正好和叶信相同。
pages.en: The next day, the prince of Wuji showed them a jade token with the same five-feathered crane.
pages.prompt: A kind young Wuji prince in jade-green court robe shows a pale-jade token with a simple five-tail white crane picture to the full team in a bright courtyard; no readable text.

pages.zh: 唐僧没有马上认定谁对谁错，而是请太子讲清王宫最近发生的每件事。
pages.en: Tang Seng did not decide who was right. He asked the prince to explain everything that had recently happened at the palace.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng listens at equal eye level while the young prince arranges harmless picture tokens showing bridge, gardener, and crane on a low table; full team attentive, no text.

pages.zh: 叶信、玉牌和太子的记忆彼此对上了。大家决定进宫，用公开问答查明真相。
pages.en: The leaf, the token, and the prince's memories matched. Together they chose a public question-and-answer meeting to learn the truth.
pages.prompt: Team and prince compare matching crane pictures on leaf and jade token, then point toward an open sunny palace courtyard prepared with equal seats; evidence-based cooperation, no text.

pages.zh: 出发前，悟空把叶信装进透明小匣：“重要线索要保存好，也要让大家都看得见。”
pages.en: Before leaving, Wukong placed the leaf in a clear case. “Important evidence should be protected and visible to everyone.”
pages.prompt: Wukong gently places the crane leaf into a clear crystal case while Tang Seng, Bajie, Sha, White Dragon Horse and prince watch approvingly; bright departure, no text.
